(def ^{:doc "remainder of dividing numerator by denominator." :arglists '([n d])} rem
  (fn [n d]
  (if (and (suss.bootstrap/number? n) (suss.bootstrap/number? d))
    (let [q (quot n d)]
      (- n (* d q)))
    (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "rem requires number operands")))))
rationale: Retain the complete pinned remainder operation; expand only defn to def/fn and use its original quotient/fix arithmetic. Clojure numeric functions reject non-number operands (#286): the operands are checked first, and a non-number throws a language error naming the function instead of coercing.
